description: THIS FILE ONLY WORKS IF THE RENOVATE GITHUB APP IS INSTALLED ON THE ORG. It is not a
workflow and nothing in CI runs it. As of 2026-08-13 the App had never run here — no
pull request, no dependency dashboard issue, no branch — which is why the GitHub Actions
below sat two majors behind until they were bumped by hand, and why the Node 20
deprecation warning appeared on every run.
If you are reading this because dependencies look stale, check the App before the config.
`description`, NOT `//`. Renovate validates every key and rejects unknown ones, so a `//`
comment key does not document the file, it stops the bot: Renovate refused this config
on 2026-08-14 and opened no dependency pull request for the twelve days after. The lesson
is the one `tooling/lighthouse/lighthouserc.json` already carries in its own header — JSON
has no comments, and inventing one breaks whichever tool parses the file.

packageRules.description: Patch updates automerge. GitHub Actions are exempted by the NEXT rule rather than by an exclusion here: `excludeManagers` is not a Renovate option and never was, and it is the second half of why this config was rejected. Later packageRules override earlier ones, so the github-actions rule below turns automerge back off for that manager — which is what the exclusion was reaching for, expressed in a way the schema accepts.

GitHub Actions are never automerged, and are pinned to a commit SHA. release.yml runs with contents:write, packages:write and id-token:write and mints npm provenance, so a compromised third-party action executes inside the job that signs our releases. The repo already checksums the one gitleaks tarball it downloads, with the comment that piping an unverified download into a shell is a poor look in the job whose purpose is supply-chain hygiene — the same standard now applies to the code around the publish. repo:check assertion 47 holds it.
typescript 7.x is the Go rewrite, not a 5.x successor. See the Why column in CLAUDE.md.
@types/node must stay major-matched to the Node pin or it types the wrong runtime.
